task: Control Plane closure: exact runtime Template Factory proof classification and workflow trigger parity for unrelated admin route changes

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This is a dependency-authority correction for a blocking cross-workflow gate; only a complete canonical runtime graph, validated producer path trigger list, and absence of explicit or transitive obligations may justify not requesting the external artifact. Unknown states retain the proof requirement.

acceptanceCriteria: Admin-only /admin/kommunikacio layout with no runtime closure intersection, nonmatching producer triggers and no explicit TF Completion evidence does not demand an impossible external TF artifact.
Touching any canonical TF runtime dependency, or a producer workflow path trigger, still requires the external Template Factory proof.
Absent or blocked runtime graph, malformed or mismatched workflow trigger patterns, explicit TF evidence, or transitive TF dependencies remain fail-closed.
The TF producer workflow must auto-trigger for edits to the cross-workflow proof classifier, on push and PR.
Negative unit tests, codebase Atlas closure, Development Guard, critical Plan Before Code, Edit-Time/Reference/Implementation Sync, Replay, Risk and exact-head CI must PASS; no gate is disabled.

Historical Fresh Install U03 regression proof remains anchored to immutable manifest, canonical CI baseline guard, and its validator rather than asserting the latest unrelated Control Plane plan mentions GUARD-CUSTOMER-BASELINE.
invariants: Preserve Template Factory Quality Gate v2, its complete 14-page/3-viewport proof, current truth authority and external artifact validator unchanged.
Use the existing canonical liveRuntime closure and workflow trigger patterns rather than an invented bypass or hand-maintained exemption list.
Do not infer proof absence from UI navigation, static naming conventions alone or missing snapshot inputs.
forbiddenStates: Any new runtime route or build dependency silently bypasses TF proof when liveRuntime closure is unavailable.
Explicit TF completion evidence requirement bypassed because planned files are unrelated.
A changed proof classifier avoids launching its own TF verification workflow.
Truth gate marked PASS by inventing an external artifact or claiming a successful workflow that never ran.
A historical U03 Fresh Install regression incorrectly fails future unrelated active plans due to checking the mutable development plan instead of the immutable proof and canonical CI baseline guard.

semanticExecutionRoute.request: Control Plane closure: exact runtime Template Factory proof classification and workflow trigger parity for unrelated admin route changes

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The blocking Template Factory guard declares overly broad src/app/** semantic inputs while its producer workflow has narrower path filters. An unrelated Pro-only admin route update is therefore forced to await impossible exact-head external evidence although the canonical Template Factory runtime closure excludes it.
observableOutcomes: A complete PASS runtime dependency closure and validated workflow trigger set may prove that an unrelated admin route change does not require a Template Factory external artifact.
If an actual template runtime, producer workflow, classification input or declared external completion dependency changes, the exact-head external proof must remain mandatory.
The producer workflow must trigger on changes to its own external proof classification code so those modifications receive the complete required external acceptance proof.
unresolvedRisks: The source runtime graph or path-filter declaration may be incomplete: absent, malformed, or unresolved authority must fail closed and retain external proof requirements.
Explicit Completion Contract TF evidence references and transitive guard dependencies may not be waived by a runtime classification result.

in: Exact-runtime external proof requirement classifier and fail-closed regression tests

out: Disable or downgrade Template Factory browser proof
